title: The Maintenance tab is last; an unenrolled unit prompts Enrol
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with view customers (and edit customers to add or change a record), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. An asset not on any schedule, and another asset with no customer.
custom_steps:
1. Find the Maintenance tab position among the asset tabs and note which tab the asset opens on.
  2. Open the Maintenance tab for a unit on no schedule.
  3. Open it for a unit with no customer.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Maintenance tab is the last tab on the asset page, after Notes; the asset still opens on Work Orders.
  • A unit on no schedule shows "This unit is not on a maintenance schedule" with Enrol.
  • For an asset with no customer, Enrol is disabled and reads "Add a customer to this unit to enrol it".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10566 (S9, The asset Maintenance tab); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S9 (confidence display copied from S11); read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
